svg.text: GPIO 26–32: Flash/PSRAM GPIO 19–20: USB D−/D+ GPIO 43–44: UART0 TX/RX
Single common ground — all modules + PSUs tied
• All NTC A0–A3 inputs: 100nF ceramic cap to GND (HF filter)
• MCP4728 on 5V via BSS138 level shifter — ADS1115/MCP23017 on 3.3V
• DS18B20: single 4.7kΩ pull-up for entire 1-Wire bus
• I²C: onboard pull-ups on ADS1115 module — do not stack pull-ups
• SM6004 current loop: 24V PSU → SM6004 → converter → ADS1115
• SSR control: 3.3V GPIO direct drive — optocoupler input only
• MCP4728 #2 (0x61): address must be reprogrammed before install
